sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.1399 of 2025 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Soro, arising out of Khaira P.S. Case No.277 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 126(2)/ 115(2)/ 109(1)/ 324(4)/ 3(5) of BNS.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel since exaggerated allegations have been made, the Petitioners may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer and submits that the Petitioner No.1 (Manas Mukhi @ Manas Kumar Mukhi) has following criminal antecedents.
"1. Khaira PS Case No.41 of 2015 U/S- 52(a) Orissa excise Act.

2. Khaira PS Case No.85 of 2018 U/S- 294/323/354 IPC 3. Khaira PS Case No.15 of 2022 U/S- 52(a) Orissa Excise Act.
Manas Mukhi @ vs State Of Orissa .... Opposite Party on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196167196/

sentences.text: Khaira PS Case No.77 of 2022 U/S- 376(2)(n)/506 IPC.

6. Khaira PS Case No.281 of 2025 U/s- 115(2)/296/75/3(5) BNS."
5. Taking note of the same and the nature of allegation qua the Petitioner No.1(Manas Mukhi @
Manas Kumar Mukhi), this Court is not inclined to entertain the ABLAPL in respect of the Petitioner No.1 (Manas Mukhi @ Manas Kumar Mukhi).
In view of the same, the ABLAPL of the Petitioner No.1 (Manas Mukhi @ Manas Kumar Mukhi) thus stands disposed of.

6. So far as the Petitioner No.2 (Pruthan Kumar Rout @ Dillip Kumar Rout) is concerned taking into account the role ascribed to him, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner No.2 (Pruthan Kumar Rout @ Dillip Kumar Rout) shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedent and nature of injury.
